title: Cave (Johnson) Sounds
description: A sound mod that replaces all cave ambiance with random Cave Johnson quotes. All Hail JK Simmons! !
body:
This is a simple sound replacement mod that changes all of the ambient cave noises to quotes from Cave Johnson, primarily from Portal 2. There are a few lines from the Perpetual Testing Initiative, and a select few from other DLCs. 

This mod is still in development, so here are some things I would like to add:
- Echo / distance in the sound effects
- Subtitles
- Different chance for each voiceline
- Location-based lines
- Official ports to Neoforge and Forge.


  For now, use Sinytra Connector and Forgeified Fabric API to hear Cave in your Forge and Neoforge modpacks.
